note: Set A is preferred because it correctly extracts the Visible camera FOV (11.9") whereas Set B only provides the incorrect Spectrometer FOV (1.9"). Set A also avoids the erroneous Visible camera array width claim (4,096 pixels) found in Set B, though both sets share similar errors confusing Camera and Spectrometer specs for the IR channel. Set B does capture UV camera FOV and IR starshade separation/IWA data that Set A misses, but the accuracy on the Visible camera specifications makes Set A more reliable for that component.
